rule_as_built: The reader splits the window's non-OK rows by STATUS alone: NO-PRIOR-HOLDINGS, and NON-POSITIVE-BASE whose held_count is 0 (the prior day held no position row), are days with no base; every other non-OK row (ALL-HOLDINGS-EXCLUDED, IMPLAUSIBLE-RETURN, FOLLOWS-DISCONTINUITY, NON-POSITIVE-BASE with held_count above 0 or null or absent, any unnamed status) is a day with a return left out; the claim is inferred when a trading day is missing or at least one day has a return left out, else measured; position in the window decides nothing.
